About the Role:
As a People Operations Coordinator at Ashby, you will play a crucial role in ensuring that all of our employees have the best possible experience working here. You will work closely with our People Operations team focusing on the day-to-day execution of various operations and tasks ranging from data entry to process creation. You'll be involved in Onboarding, Organizational updates, and supporting our employees across our international entities.
What you'll do at Ashby:
Provide operational support and maintain accurate employee data and files across all systems in accordance with state and federal laws
Provide administrative support to Ashby's people processes, including but not limited to new hire onboarding, benefits administration, performance management, and support for our international entities
Document people process changes as needed
Maintain high level of confidentiality and discretion in the handling of sensitive information
Building out people process workflows in Ashby to continuously improve our business effectiveness
Support planning and coordination of Ashby culture events, both virtual and in-person
You could be a great fit if you:
Investigate problems to determine root causes and define robust solutions
Are detail-oriented, especially when it comes to data quality
Work independently, managing multiple tasks and deadlines effectively
Are an excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing
Are team-oriented, with a collaborative approach to solving problems
Recognize that Sensitive/confidential information must be handled compliantly
Have experience with the use of HRIS, like Gusto, Remote, Deel
Bonus points if you:
Have experience working in a Human Resources function
Have qualifications in Human Resources
Have worked in a SaaS Company
This role may not be a fit if:
Youâre uncomfortable with ambiguity: You prefer well defined assignments.
